question: What are the names of the teachers and how many courses do they teach?
gold_query: SELECT teacher.first_name , teacher.last_name , count(*) FROM course_arrange JOIN teacher ON course_arrange.Teacher_ID = teacher.Teacher_ID GROUP BY teacher.first_name , teacher.last_name
